source_title: A Role for Thalamic Projection GABAergic Neurons in Circadian Responses to Light
node_relevance_reason: Sox14+ IGL/LGv GABAergic neurons: axonal projections to SC, SCN, AHN and contralateral LGN by Cre-dependent tracing.
summary: Cre-dependent tracing from Sox14+ IGL/LGv neurons shows dense innervation of superficial SC with sparse SCN, hypothalamic and contralateral LGN projections. IGL and LGv are GABAergic prethalamic/thalamic territories that give rise to the geniculohypothalamic tract regulating the SCN clock. IGL/LGv GABAergic projection neurons receive input from diverse RGC classes but not M1 ipRGCs and are required for circadian entrainment to dim light and vigilance-state transitions.
quotes: Notably, dense innervation was seen in the superficial gray and optic layers of the superior colliculus (SCs; Fig. 1M), while few immunoreactive fibers were present at the ventral edge of the SCN (Fig. 1N)
GABAergic projection neurons are present at the rostroventral edges of the mouse thalamus to form the intergeniculate leaflet (IGL; Morin and Blanchard, 1999, 2001, 2005).
The IGL and LGv are the source of the geniculohypothalamic tract

Our results show that thalamic GABAergic neurons of the IGL and LGv receive retinal input from diverse classes of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) but not from the M1 intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cell (ipRGC) type.

source_title: Diverse GABAergic neurons organize into subtype-specific sublaminae in the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus
section: | Do laminated retinorecipient circuits organize visual pathways through the vLGN?
node_relevance_reason: Lists vLGN projection targets (SC, pretectum, SCN, habenula, zona incerta) and notes GABAergic vLGN neurons projecting to LHb.
summary: vLGN neurons project to over a dozen subcortical targets including SC, pretectal nuclei, SCN, habenula and zona incerta; some retinorecipient GABAergic cells project to lateral habenula. Novel markers label GABAergic vLGN cells and distinguish vLGN from dLGN, sometimes from IGL; at least four transcriptionally distinct sublaminae in vLGNe, absent from IGL. Pvalb+, Penk+, Spp1+, Ecel1+ and Lypd1+ GABAergic neurons form segregated strata across the vLGN dorso-ventral axis.
quotes: neurons in vLGN project to a diverse set of over a dozen downstream subcortical regions including the SC, the nucleus of the optic tract and other pretectal nuclei
It is known that some GABAergic cells in vLGN receive retinal input and project to the lateral habenula, although it remains unclear which GABAergic subtypes this includes (Huang et al., 2019).
In this study, we identified novel vLGN cell-type markers which label GABAergic cells throughout the nucleus and distinguish it from its dorsal counterpart-the dLGN.
Interestingly, such organization was absent from IGL, even for cell types present in both regions.

Importantly, not only did these cells have regional preferences, but Pvalb + , Penk + , Spp1 + , Ecel1 + , and Lypd1 + neurons each appeared to be organized into segregated strata that span the dorso-ventral axis of the vLGN.

source_title: Divergent outputs of the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus mediate visually evoked defensive behaviors
section: Divergent vLGN outputs exert opposite influences on defensive behaviors
node_relevance_reason: Retrograde tracing shows ~90% of vLGN-to-SC neurons are Vgat+ GABAergic (Gad1/Gad2 types) with a ~10% Vglut2+ minority.
summary: The majority of SC-projecting vLGN cells are GABAergic; vLGN GABA neurons also project to nucleus reuniens via a distinct pathway. AAV-DIO-GFP in Gad2-Cre vLGN labels GABA axons in SC and Re; SC- and Re-projecting cells are distinct populations.
quotes: The majority of vLGN cells that project to the SC were Vgat+ (~90%; i.e., GABAergic), which consists of both Gad2 and Gad1 cell types
We observed GFP-expressing vLGN GABA axons in the SC (Figure 5B) and in the Re (Figures 5C and S3)
Two-color retrograde labeling of vLGN cells that project to the SC (in green) or to the Re (in red) confirmed that the vLGN→SC and vLGN→Re circuits represent distinct vLGN output pathways

source_title: Enhancement and contextual modulation of visuospatial processing by thalamocollicular projections from ventral lateral geniculate nucleus
node_relevance_reason: vLGN is predominantly GABAergic with long-range inhibitory projections to SC, midbrain reticular nucleus, PAG and nucleus reuniens.
summary: vLGN is mainly GABAergic, does not project to cortex, and sends inhibitory projections to SC, PAG, Re and others (LHb, PAG, Re linked to light-dependent effects). GABAergic thalamocollicular projections from vLGN produce surround suppression of SC visuospatial processing. vLGN VGAT+ axons project to superficial SC; neighbouring IGL also projects to superficial SC.
quotes: Unlike the dLGN, the vLGN is predominantly populated by GABAergic neurons [7][8][9] and does not project to the visual cortex 7 .

it sends long-range inhibitory projections to subcortical visual and visuomotor areas in the thalamus and midbrain including the superior colliculus (SC), midbrain reticular nucleus, periaqueductal gray (PAG) and nucleus reuniens (Re)
Through GABAergic thalamocollicular projections, vLGN specifically exerts prominent surround suppression of visuospatial processing in SC
two areas neighboring vLGN, the intergeniculate leaflet (IGL) and ZI, contain GABAergic neurons which also project to SC

source_title: A visual circuit related to the parabrachial nucleus for the antipruritic effects of bright light treatment.
node_relevance_reason: RGCs innervate GABAergic vLGN/IGL neurons that project to lateral parabrachial nucleus.
summary: GABAergic neurons of vLGN/IGL inhibit CaMKIIa+ neurons in the lateral parabrachial nucleus, mediating antipruritic effects of bright light.
quotes: a subset of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) innervates GABAergic neurons in the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus and intergeniculate leaflet (vLGN/IGL), which subsequently inhibit CaMKIIα+ neurons in the LPBN.

section: Downstream pathways and behavioral significance of retinal contrast detection.

summary: GABAergic neurons in vLGN and IGL projecting to LHb mediate antidepressant effects of light; CaMKIIa vLGN/IGL neurons project to reuniens.
quotes: First, sONα RGCs innervate GABAergic neurons in the vLGN and IGL that project to the lateral habenula (LHb) and mediate antidepressant effects of light (Huang et al. 2019).

source_title: An autoradiographic study of the projections from the lateral geniculate body of the rat.
node_relevance_reason: Classic autoradiographic tracing of rat vLGN efferents to SC and pretectum.
summary: vLGN projects ipsilaterally to superior colliculus (stratum opticum) and to ipsilateral and contralateral pretectal areas.
quotes: One dorsomedial projection coursed caudally from the vLGN through the brachium of the superior colliculus to terminate in the ipsilateral superior colliculus
The second dorsomedial projection seemed to course medially and terminate in the ipsilateral and contralateral pretectal areas

source_title: A High‐Resolution Transcriptomic Atlas of Cell Types in the Ventral Visual Thalamus
node_relevance_reason: snRNA-seq atlas of mouse vLGN: most neurons GABAergic, 20 neuron types.
summary: Transcriptomic atlas of vLGN identifies 20 neuron types, most GABAergic including projection neurons, with at least two excitatory types. Segregation into sublaminae may specify parallel visual pathways; vLGN inhibitory neurons are primarily projection neurons.
quotes: While principal retinorecipient neurons in dLGN are excitatory thalamocortical relay cells (TRCs), most neurons in vLGN are GABAergic, including GABAergic projection neurons.

If these inhibitory neurons are primarily projection neurons, then the high inhibition in visual processing between nuclei (as opposed to local inhibition within a nucleus) may suggest roles for vLGN in modulating defensive behaviors and visuospatial processing.

source_title: Not a one-trick pony: Diverse connectivity and functions of the rodent lateral geniculate complex
node_relevance_reason: Review: vLGN laminar organisation (vLGNe/vLGNi) and predominantly GABAergic neuron population.
summary: vLGN has magnocellular retinorecipient external and parvocellular internal laminae and a vastly higher GABAergic proportion than dLGN. A large fraction of IGL neurons are GABAergic with a shared embryonic origin with vLGNe, but IGL has classes (e.g. NPY) absent from vLGN.
quotes: Thus, in contrast to dLGN where glutamatergic neurons are the major cell type, vLGN contains a vastly higher population of GABAergic neurons
A large fraction of neurons in IGL generate GABA (Moore & Speh, 1993), few are glutamatergic, and none project axons to visual cortex (Harrington, 1997).

source_title: Pattern of Driver-Like Input onto Neurons of the Mouse Ventral Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
node_relevance_reason: vLGN overwhelmingly GABAergic; Pvalb and Penk in vLGNe, calbindin in vLGNi, Nxph1/Arx region markers.
summary: Parvalbumin and proenkephalin neurons reside in vLGNe, calbindin neurons in vLGNi; Nxph1 marks vLGNe and Arx vLGNi. vLGNe neurons receive convergent retinal and layer V cortical input; vLGNi receives cortical but not retinal input.
quotes: parvalbumin-and proenkephalin-expressing neurons residing exclusively in vLGNe and calbindin-expressing neurons residing in vLGNi (Sabbagh et al., 2021)
By contrast, vLGNi neurons receive input from visual cortex, but not from the retina.

quotes: Studies previously found that vLGNe consists of transcriptionally distinct GABAergic subtypes distributed into at least four adjacent laminae.
